ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/off-white) interior pixels comprising approximately 70% of the visible area, with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated along the trailing edges, peduncle junction, and central notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white regions occupy the central lobes; black pigmentation extends vertically from the peduncle into a triangular notch field; numerous dark-pixel 'bullseye' rings and irregular mottling are distributed stochastically across the light-intensity fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; approximate interior pixel angle of 52 degrees and high bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 4 and 12 pixels; serrations are most pronounced on the medial-to-distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the trailing edge, terminating in sharply tapered and slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters (dark rings with light centers) scattered globally; dense clusters of high-intensity calcified pixels (barnacles) visible on the extreme left and right tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned dark linear streaks visible on the medial-lower portion of the right lobe and upper-medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable structural irregularity and textured mass (barnacle colonization) on the right distal tip; minor jagged tissue loss on the left distal tip trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple 'bullseye' pigmentation patterns consisting of dark circular perimeters with high-intensity centers, specifically concentrated in the mid-lobe regions.
